path_class_rules.early_winner_with_giveback: first-four-day active MFE >= 2%; terminal active return <= 0 or <= 25% of that early MFE
path_class_rules.early_loser_with_recovery: first-four-day active MAE <= -2%; terminal is positive or recovers at least 75% of the early trough
path_class_rules.immediate_winner: day-2 active return >= 2%, terminal active return > 0, and no early-winner giveback classification
path_class_rules.delayed_winner: terminal active return >= 1%, day-2 active return <= 0, and time to MFE is after day 2
path_class_rules.persistent_loser: terminal active return <= -1% and no more than 25% of legal holding days have positive active return
path_class_rules.flat_nonresponsive: terminal absolute active return < 0.75% and full-path active range < 2%
path_class_rules.volatile_oscillation: full-path active range >= 4% and at least two active-return sign changes
path_class_rules.unclassified_mixed: path does not satisfy any predeclared diagnostic class

exit_policy_rules.hold_to_te1: close on the final observed session strictly before T_e
exit_policy_rules.fixed_2_day: close on legal holding day 2, or T_e-1 when fewer than two sessions exist
exit_policy_rules.fixed_4_day: close on legal holding day 4, or T_e-1 when fewer than four sessions exist
exit_policy_rules.fixed_8_day: close on legal holding day 8, or T_e-1 when fewer than eight sessions exist
exit_policy_rules.corrected_reference_exit: preserve the corrected kernel exit exactly
exit_policy_rules.volatility_scaled_stop: from day 2, close when stock close return breaches max(2%, 2x pre-entry ATR20), capped at 8%; otherwise T_e-1
exit_policy_rules.time_underwater_exit: from day 4, close after four consecutive sessions with negative active return; otherwise T_e-1
exit_policy_rules.trailing_profit_giveback_exit: after active close return reaches 3%, close on giveback of max(1.5 points, 50% of peak); otherwise T_e-1

research_frozen_selector.label: research_frozen_selector_stage2e
research_frozen_selector.direct_ranking: OOF predicted active return per slot-day descending then expected slot days
research_frozen_selector.direct_admission: OOF predicted Target B per slot-day > 0
research_frozen_selector.selection_rule: minimum 50% median plus 50% 75th-percentile composite rank across all eight predeclared exits and both benchmarks; composite equally ranks excess return, active IR, and less-negative active drawdown
research_frozen_selector.indirect_mapping_eligibility_and_ranking: unchanged Stage 2C semantic lane: mapping confidence >=3, event-relative semantic rank, novelty/repricing guard
research_frozen_selector.terminal_label_caveat: Target B remains T_e-1 active return divided by slot days; it is frozen only because its OOF selector survived the cross-exit matrix, not because the training label became path-aware
